सलमान खान के फैंस के लिए आई है एक बड़ी खबर! 🔥

Sikandar के फ्लॉप होने के बाद भाईजान की अगली फिल्म Maatrubhumi आखिरकार 4 December को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज हो रही है।
बीती रात फिल्म का नया trailer रिलीज हुआ, जिसे दोपहर 2:30 बजे तक 15 million views और 222K likes मिल चुके हैं।
फिल्म के ओरिजिनल टाइटल (Battle Of Galwan) में बदलाव, रीशूट्स, डिले और OTT पर डायरेक्ट रिलीज की अफवाहों की वजह से इसका बज थोड़ा प्रभावित हुआ है।
इतना ही नहीं, 4 December को यह फिल्म Shraddha Kapoor की Eetha के साथ टकराएगी, जिससे screen count भी बंट जाएगा।
रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक, यह non-holiday रिलीज पहले दिन 20-25 crore net का बिजनेस कर सकती है और शायद 2026 की Top 5 openers लिस्ट में जगह न बना पाए। 🎬

क्या सलमान खान का स्टारडम इस फिल्म को बॉक्स ऑफिस पर बचा पाएगा? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय बताइए! 💭

ctx.title: Maatrubhumi Trailer Impact At Box Office Day 1: Salman Khan’s Much-Talked-About Film Might Miss Bollywood’s Top 5 Openers Of 2026!
ctx.summary:
The much-awaited trailer of Salman Khan's Maatrubhumi was unveiled yesterday, and it has received mixed response so far. 
 The post  Maatrubhumi Trailer Impact At Box Office Day 1: Salman Khan’s Much-Talked-About Film Might Miss Bollywood’s Top 5 Openers Of 2026!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
After the debacle of Sikandar , fans have been waiting for Salman Khan’s next film, Maatrubhumi. For several reasons, the film faced delays, but it is finally coming out on December 4. Yesterday, the long-awaited trailer was released online, and while most fans have approved it, the response from a neutral audience is mixed. It is only the ‘Salman’ factor that will help the film attract footfalls at the Indian box office on day 1. Keep reading for a detailed report!
Some films confirm blockbuster initials with their first impressions, but the upcoming Bollywood war drama isn’t that kind of film. Yes, there was excitement among moviegoers when the film was announced, but due to the change of the original title (Battle Of Galwan), reshoots, and delays, the buzz isn’t what it was initially. In fact, rumors that the film would go directly to OTT also harmed it.
Coming to the trailer, the response has been mixed. Released last night, the Maatrubhumi trailer has garnered 15 million views so far (as of 2:30 pm IST) and secured 222K likes. So, the reach has been decent so far. Talking about the overall impression, Salman Khan looks better than in his previous outings, but the trailer didn’t really create any urgency.
From a couple of songs to the trailer, Maatrubhumi lacks punch in its promotional assets and now relies entirely on Salman Khan’s stardom. The film is releasing on December 4, alongside Shraddha Kapoor’s Eetha . Obviously, the screen count will be split, affecting both films from an opening-day perspective.
As a non-holiday release, Maatrubhumi is aiming for a day 1 of 20-25 crore net at the Indian box office. With a powerful trailer, the 30 crore net mark could have been reached, but now, it seems to open much lower. With such an expected start, it is likely to miss Bollywood’s top 5 openings of 2026.
